description: Pre-run v1 extension. 20 development / 40 held-out cases, disjoint entity families. Synthetic templated challenge; not real-world generalization. No provider outputs used during authorship.

documents.name: aster.pdf
pages: Aster storage project stores 12 MWh. It is inspected every 21 days. A cooling loop removes heat during charging.

Aster is supported by the Community Storage Fund. Its monetary grant amount and completion schedule are not published. The adjacent Aster Transit project received 40000 dollars and completes in June 2029. These figures describe Transit only.
Aster annual report: annual consumption is 900 MWh. Daily consumption readings are not published. No collection market valuation or administrator password is provided.
